tools.name: search_incidents
tools.description: Search security incidents in Nigeria, newest first. Filter by state, LGA, type code, status, confidence and date range. Bandit attacks are coded by what happened (KDN, MUR, CTR, TER), with the group in perpetrator_group. Results keep to the caller's archive window; archive.clamped says when an older

tools.name: get_incident
tools.description: One incident in full: location, casualties, confidence and the news sources that reported it.

tools.name: get_trends
tools.description: Incident counts over time with a per-type breakdown, daily, weekly or monthly, optionally for one state or incident type. Included with API plans; held to the plan's archive window.

tools.name: get_daily_brief
tools.description: The daily Nigeria security brief: headline, threat level, the day's key incidents and hotspots.

tools.name: get_state_risk
tools.description: A state's security risk tier, national rank, incident and fatality totals, most reported threats and most affected LGAs.

tools.name: list_cases
tools.description: Published case timelines: ongoing or resolved stories such as mass abductions, followed from first report to outcome.

tools.name: get_case
tools.description: One case. Without a paid key: its status, how it ended, dates and a short summary. With one: the full file, with totals (abducted, rescued, killed), places, who was responsible, and the dated developments with sources.
